subject: Application: Associate Product Manager — Loop health
htmlBody:
Hi Navneet Ringania,

Your search for a Product Manager who prioritizes understanding why a product works, not just that it shipped, immediately resonated with my approach to building products from deep user insights.

A little bit about myself:

  • I conceived and built PolicyBandhu, a 0-to-1 conversational AI assistant, by uncovering that user distrust and cognitive exhaustion from complex fine print were the primary barriers to insurance purchases. This product directly addresses those insights, providing transparent clause breakdowns.
  • My focus is always on measuring outcomes and understanding why they occur. For PolicyBandhu, this meant tracking reduced support overhead and improved Net Promoter Score (NPS). At ShipTurtle, I structured advanced AI product evaluations and defined clear success metrics for production rollouts.
  • I let user proximity drive decisions, not frameworks. My analyses for CRED and The Good Bug, for instance, focused on diagnosing core user friction points to propose solutions that genuinely move the needle, rather than leading with roadmaps.

I'm particularly drawn to Loop Health's emphasis on 'sitting with real users, in person' to uncover problems and the commitment to 'every launch gets a verdict' on whether the problem was truly solved. This high-ownership, outcome-driven approach aligns perfectly with my experience building products from deep user insights and validating their impact.

I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to Loop health's growth.

For your reference, you can view my Portfolio (reachable at +91 7987177269), connect with me on LinkedIn, or review my CV.

Best regards,
Shikhar Gupta
